turns.q: Tell me about the Grand Deluxe room.
turns.reply: The Grand Deluxe rooms come in two types: Grand Deluxe Giường Đôi and Grand Deluxe 2 Giường Đơn, both with a size of 42 m². They feature a bedroom with a queen bed or two twin beds, respectively, and can accommodate up to 4 guests (3 adults + 1 child or 2 adults + 2 children). They include amenities such as air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a safe, free Wi-Fi, a minibar, daily housekeeping, room service, luggage storage, and a bathroom with a bathtub and shower. Grand Deluxe rooms also offer ocean view options.

turns.q: Does it have an ocean view?
turns.reply: Yes, all the types of rooms mentioned (Ocean View Twin Bed, Ocean View Queen Bed, Suite King Ocean View, and Deluxe Ocean View) have an ocean view.

turns.q: And what time can I check in to it?
turns.reply: Standard check-in is at 14:00. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is not granted before 12:00 without a charge.
